```{r}
#| eval: true
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| label: fig-k-Nearest-Neighbour
#| layout-ncol: 2
#| fig-cap:
#|   - New observation shown with all training points.
#|   - Nearest k points highlighted for the new observation.

library(tidyverse)

# Variables
k <- 7

# Data
data <- iris |>
    dplyr::select(Petal.Width, Sepal.Width, Species)

new_point <- tibble(Petal.Width = 0.75, Sepal.Width = 3)

# Compute Euclidean distance from each observation to the new point
data_knn <- data |>
    dplyr::mutate(
        distance = sqrt(
            (Petal.Width - new_point$Petal.Width)^2 +
            (Sepal.Width - new_point$Sepal.Width)^2
        ),
        neighbor_rank = rank(distance, ties.method = "first"),
        is_neighbor = neighbor_rank <= k
    )

nearest_points <- data_knn |>
    dplyr::arrange(distance) |>
    dplyr::slice_head(n = k)

plot_all_points <- ggplot(data_knn, aes(x = Petal.Width, y = Sepal.Width)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = Species), alpha = 0.75, size = 2.8) +
    geom_point(
        data = new_point,
        aes(x = Petal.Width, y = Sepal.Width),
        color = "black",
        fill = "gold",
        shape = 23,
        size = 4,
        stroke = 1.2
    ) +
    labs(
        title = "",
        x = "Petal Width",
        y = "Sepal Width",
        color = "Species"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")

plot_nearest_k <- ggplot(data_knn, aes(x = Petal.Width, y = Sepal.Width)) +
    geom_point(color = "grey80", size = 2.2) +
    geom_segment(
        data = nearest_points,
        aes(
            x = new_point$Petal.Width,
            y = new_point$Sepal.Width,
            xend = Petal.Width,
            yend = Sepal.Width
        ),
        color = "grey50",
        linewidth = 0.5,
        linetype = "dashed"
    ) +
    geom_point(
        data = nearest_points,
        aes(color = Species),
        size = 3.4
    ) +
    geom_point(
        data = new_point,
        aes(x = Petal.Width, y = Sepal.Width),
        color = "black",
        fill = "gold",
        shape = 23,
        size = 4,
        stroke = 1.2
    ) +
    labs(
        title = "",
        x = "Petal Width",
        y = "Sepal Width",
        color = "Species"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")

plot_all_points
plot_nearest_k
```
